name: Rathouisiidae

children.name: Barkeriella
children.auth: Manganelli, Lesicki, Benocci, Barbato, Miserocchi, Pieńkowska & Fo. Giusti, 2022

desc: Rathouisiidae is a family of carnivorous air-breathing land slugs, terrestrial pulmonate gastropod molluscs in the superfamily Veronicelloidea, the leatherleaf slugs and their allies.
